name: BST Lab
desc: An AVL-tree lab: a self-balancing binary search tree with rotations after every insert and delete, showing height, balance factors and the AVL height bound live.
controls: Insert-count and value-range sliders, three presets (random/sorted/reverse), insert/delete/search/clear buttons, balance-factor toggle; keys 1–3 load presets, I inserts, D deletes, S searches, C clears
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
